easyPrerequisites: There are at least five land card(s) in all graveyards
description:
Activate Centaur Vinecrasher by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Centaur Vinecrasher enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Centaur Vinecrasher enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Centaur Vinecrasher.
Activate Centaur Vinecrasher using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
